Eve - Album 1: WHO

The Order of the Veilguards

"Some became allies, some became friends, one became family"

[Intro]

One lamp burning One room below One line about me I wasn’t meant to know

I keep searching Because stopping now Would leave me with questions And no way out

[Verse 1]

Behind a stack of records Under dust and broken ties I find a bound manifest Different from the rest inside

Names arranged in columns Dates across the page Symbols I have seen before Repeated age to age

The same old crest The same strange sign The one stamped through the books upstairs

And beneath it Written clearly

The Order of the Veilguards

[Pre-Chorus]

I thought monsters were stories Warnings from another time

But this doesn’t read like folklore

This reads like a record This reads like a crime

[Chorus]

The Order of the Veilguards Created to defend When something crossed from somewhere else And hunger followed in

The Order of the Veilguards Standing where the boundaries frayed Watching what appeared without warning And protecting those who stayed

If these pages tell the truth Then everything I knew was wrong

The monsters weren’t imagined

They were here All along

[Verse 2]

People disappeared at midnight Others vanished in the day Some returned with wounds and memories That never went away

Some were fed upon and rescued Some were never found again Some came home completely altered Still alive but not the same

Things appeared without an entrance Then disappeared without a trace Creatures no one could explain From somewhere beyond this place

So someone started watching Someone learned to stand between

Not to hunt what they discovered

But to guard what crossed unseen

[Pre-Chorus]

Study Protect Contain Understand

Learn what comes through Before raising a hand

Because not everything crossing Came hunting for prey

Some only arrived

And decided to stay

[Chorus]

The Order of the Veilguards Created to defend Not every creature was an enemy Not every crossing had to end

The Order of the Veilguards Keeping records through the years Learning which arrivals carried hunger And which arrivals carried fear

If these pages tell the truth Then legends had it wrong

The monsters weren’t imagined

But neither were they all monsters All along

[Verse 3]

Twelve major families Fifteen minor houses Names repeating through generations Under vows and ancient clauses

A pact maintained for centuries Bloodlines carrying the weight Teaching every generation How to watch and how to wait

Then one entry breaks the pattern

Eighteen years ago

One household withdrew completely

One name I already know

Mary

No explanation No reason written down

Only that she left the Order And abandoned what she’d known

Eighteen years

I count again

Eighteen years

The year I began

[Bridge]

Why did you leave? Why did you hide?

Why did you take me And close this world outside?

Why was my name Inside your private page?

Why does my birthday Match the moment you walked away?

I turn through reports Looking for anything more

Then one old document Stops me cold

Crossings are not always hostile

Some arrivals remained

Some learned our language

Some learned our names

Some became allies

Some became friends

And one

Became family

[Final Chorus]

The Order of the Veilguards Suddenly this isn’t lore It’s something Grandma lived inside Before she locked the door

The Order of the Veilguards Twelve families, fifteen more Centuries protecting people From whatever crossed before

But Mary walked away The year that I arrived

And somewhere in these records Is the reason she decided

That monsters could be dangerous

That monsters could be kind

That something crossed a boundary

And changed our family line

[Outro]

The lamp is getting weaker

Morning can’t be far

Mary’s diary beside me The manifest in my arms

Eleven keys

One open door

One Order I never knew

And one final sentence I cannot stop reading through

Some became allies

Some became friends

One became family

I touch the necklace at my chest

And turn the page
